_note: 1.81.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md, release A1): the shared event frame's data. chances: optional things {{user}} may do at an event (data/calendar.json event id -> list), never required and never reminded. Each is done once a campaign year (max: how many times). how: at (place keys, lowercase without 'the'), day (the event day it belongs to, else any of its days), from / to ('HH:MM'; 'to' may pass 24:00 into the next event day), min (minutes the reply covers there), said (a regex the reply's text must match), club ({{user}} is in a club), trip (the Trip is active or the Location matches this regex), practice (a /Practice action accepted this reply), other_dorm (its partner is from another dorm), deed (a /Rep_events kind reported this reply). reward: prof [Field, XP] ('club' = the club's Field; uncapped, as the 1.26.0 event XP was), moment (a line in the Recent moments of every Rank 3+ bond present), or nothing (the chance only marks it done). legacy: the key the 1.26.0 event XP used ($eng.prof.days 'event:<year>:<key>'), read as done so a save never pays twice. Engine: stepProficiency (eventChances); UI: the Activities Event tab.

contest._note: 1.82.0 (planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md section 3, release A2): the Dorm Competition, computed from the seed and never stored (shared.js contest section; tools/common.py presence_data hands it to the engine and the panels as PD.ct). roles: a Halvard student's combat role in the brackets (owner-approved draft table 3.4; Castor by his public magic). pins: only what the lore says (str: strength added; lose: the round they go out in, 'semi' = the semi-final; tie: 'first' wins the tie for the better of the places shared by that round's losers; years: campaign years the pin holds). dorm: bracket size per role per dorm, qualifying places (lore 19), each role's format and the rounds' times. strength: an entrant's (base + per_year x (school year - 1) + 0..spread), {{user}}'s (user_base + user_per_year x (Year - 1) + user_per_prowess x Prowess rank); a bout between two entrants the narrator does not play goes to A with 50 + (A - B) percent, clamped; edge: the gap that makes an opponent stronger or weaker (Fortune -10 / +10). vote: the Club Festival coin vote, drawn at the close weighted by (named members + base), with {{user}}'s club boosted for each of its chances done.
